description: Full details for one course: what it covers, how it is assessed, the pre-course online work, what to bring, when the certificate is issued, and how long it stays current. Use it to answer whether a course meets a workplace or childcare requirement. course is the id from list_courses; a unit code such as HLTAID011 also works.

course.description: The course's id, unit code, workshops course id or name.

name: get_course_details

certificate.description: How and when the certificate is issued.

code.description: The national unit code, such as HLTAID011.

delivery.description: How the course is delivered, including any e-Learning pre-work.

duration.description: How long the course takes, as the site describes it.

id.description: The course's slug, such as first-aid. Every other endpoint accepts it as course.

price_aud.description: The standard price in Australian dollars, GST included.

price_display.description: The price as the site shows it, such as $97.

renewal.description: How often the certificate should be renewed.

url.description: The course's page on the site.

what_to_bring.description: What to bring on the day.

title: Get course details
